literal: Let associate blemish-without-those friendship; something even having given, let abandon compatibility-without-those friendship.
translation: Cultivate the friendship of the flawless. Even if you must give something up to do so, abandon the friendship of the incompatible.
modern: குற்றமற்றவர்களின் நட்பை விரும்பி ஏற்றுக்கொள்ள வேண்டும். ஒத்த பண்பு இல்லாதவர்களின் நட்பை, அவர்களுக்கு ஏதாவது ஒரு பொருளைக் கொடுத்தாவது விட்டுவிட வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet advises on the active choices one must make regarding companions. It urges us to embrace the friendship of those who are flawless in their character. Conversely, it stresses the importance of abandoning friendship with those who lack compatibility or proper conduct, even if it requires giving up something valuable to sever the tie. The phrase 'even having given something' highlights that escaping bad company is worth any material cost.
